name: claude-code-controller
description: Revive Claude Code Remote Control for BYOK users by injecting the Bun-compiled binary via inspector and re-hosting the /remote-control control-plane on a self-run server.

scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U ccc -d ccc
scripts.test: node --test test/protocol.test.ts test/server.test.ts test/auth.test.ts test/fixtures.test.ts test/transcript.test.ts test/model.test.ts test/web-channel.test.ts test/pwa.test.ts test/push-event.test.ts test/control-cli.test.ts test/db.test.ts
